title: Streaming Text to Speech
description: Bidirectional streaming text-to-speech via WebSocket. Send text incrementally and receive audio chunks in real time. Shares the `/v1/tts` path with the batch POST endpoint — a GET with `Upgrade: websocket` activates streaming mode. Configuration is done via query parameters at connection time. Supports multi-utterance: after `audio.done`, send another stream of `text.delta` messages on the same connection.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token for authentication. Use your xAI API key.

queryParameters.name: voice
queryParameters.description: Voice identifier. Use a built-in voice from `GET /v1/tts/voices` (e.g. `eve`, `ara`) or a custom voice ID.

queryParameters.name: language
queryParameters.description: BCP-47 language code (e.g. `en`, `zh`, `pt-BR`) or `auto` for automatic language detection. Case-insensitive.

queryParameters.name: bit_rate
queryParameters.description: Bit rate in bps. Only applies when `codec` is `mp3`.

queryParameters.name: optimize_streaming_latency
queryParameters.description: Latency optimization level. `0` (default): No optimization — best audio quality. `1`: Reduced first-chunk size for lower time-to-first-audio, with minor quality tradeoff at chunk boundaries.

queryParameters.name: speed
queryParameters.description: Speech speed multiplier. `1.0` is normal speed. Values below `1.0` slow down speech, values above `1.0` speed it up. Range: `0.7` to `1.5`.

queryParameters.name: text_normalization
queryParameters.description: Enable text normalization before synthesis. When enabled, the model normalizes written-form text (e.g. numbers, abbreviations, symbols) into spoken-form before generating audio.

queryParameters.name: with_timestamps
queryParameters.description: Return per-character timing metadata on each `audio.delta` event. When `true`, every `audio.delta` carries `audio_timestamps`.

clientMessages.description: Send a chunk of text to be synthesized. Text is processed incrementally — audio generation begins as soon as enough text is buffered. Individual deltas are capped at 60,000 characters.

delta.description: Text chunk to synthesize. Supports speech tags like `[laugh]`, `[pause]`, `[whisper]`.

example.delta: Hello! Welcome to streaming text to speech.

clientMessages.description: Signal that all text for this utterance has been sent. The server will finish generating audio and send `audio.done`. After receiving `audio.done`, you can start a new utterance with another `text.delta`.

serverMessages.description: A chunk of base64-encoded audio data. Decode and append to your audio buffer or pipe directly to playback. The format matches the `codec` and `sample_rate` specified in the query parameters. When the connection was opened with `with_timestamps=true`, the event also carries `audio_timestamps` and `audio_duration` for the characters that fall inside this chunk.

audio_timestamps.description: Per-character forced-alignment timings for this chunk. Present only when the connection was opened with `with_timestamps=true`. Times are session-relative seconds, so they are directly comparable across chunks within an utterance.

graph_chars.description: Each character covered by this audio chunk, in order. Includes spaces, punctuation, and any speech tag characters from the original input.

graph_times.description: Parallel array of `[start, end]` seconds for each entry in `graph_chars`.

audio_duration.description: Duration of this audio chunk in seconds. Present only when the connection was opened with `with_timestamps=true`.

serverMessages.description: Audio generation for this utterance is complete. The connection remains open for multi-utterance — send another `text.delta` to start a new synthesis, or close the connection.

trace_id.description: Unique trace identifier for this utterance. Useful for debugging.

serverMessages.description: An error occurred during synthesis. The connection may be closed after this message.
